rows.name: 01-forgot-the-agreement
rows.hook: Your agent did not forget the code. It forgot the agreement.
rows.relate: A fresh session can see the repository and still miss what changed, what passed, and what happens next.

rows.name: 02-done-is-not-a-feeling
rows.relate: A green local test does not prove a merge, a deploy, or production verification.

rows.name: 03-context-window-hygiene
rows.hook: A 200,000-token window can still have bad handoff hygiene.
rows.relate: More chat history does not create one authoritative objective or one exact next action.

rows.name: 04-wrong-skill
rows.hook: The wrong skill can be worse than no skill.
rows.relate: A vague task should not load every capability or let the first familiar tool choose the method.

rows.name: 05-three-things
rows.hook: Three things every resumed agent should see.
rows.relate: Continuity becomes useful when the next agent can act without replaying the entire project.
